payload.purchase_url_note: checkout_url is a Tutu checkout-mode deeplink. It mints the cart for the offer pack in the opener's session (a cold browser works) ONLY when offer_pack_hash is a ROOM rate's `offerpack_hash` from `get_offer_details`. The listing `best_offer.offerpack_hash` does NOT mint a cart — it lands on the hotel page, as does a stale pack (fallback_to_details). So present this as 'opens your chosen room in the cart' only if you passed a room-level hash the user picked; otherwise tell the user they'll pick the room on the page. Do NOT promise a ready cart for a listing hash.
